text_blocks.snippet: Sears is not currently offering life insurance policies. In the past, Sears did offer group life insurance to its employees, including retirees. However, due to financial difficulties and bankruptcy proceedings, Sears ended these benefits for many retirees, requiring them to convert to individual policies at their own expense or lose coverage. There is a $3 million settlement fund for some former employees who were affected by the canceled benefits.
